fields.description: The ERPNext Product Bundle this combo presents. Components, and the stock decrement that follows them, live there — this record only decides how the register shows it.
fields.label: Product Bundle

fields.description: Lower sorts first in the Combos category and in the “se suele llevar junto” strip.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Items this combo is FOR. Leave empty for a universal combo, which is offered on every ticket. When set, the combo is only suggested once one of these items is in the cart.
fields.label: Targets

fields.description: Device models this combo is FOR, named by the shop's entry attribute (the Item Attribute its Storefront Profile points at — phones → «Modelos Celulares»). One row covers every accessory carrying that value, so «Samsung A01» does not have to be spelled out case by case. Counts as targeting: a combo with rows here is no longer universal.
fields.label: Device Targets
